feature: ADR-0083 Linux isolated worker process group

linux.custom_main_parent_harness: passed; isolated sealed-config mode added without device access
linux.abi: GNU C oracle extends getpgrp/getpid prototypes; no device or signal calls

windows.scope: new logic Linux-cfg only; earlier native and portable checks still pending after automatic approval quota failure; no new invocation

limitations: No real VT, evdev/uinput, Hook/SendInput, driver, foreground signal or actual terminal Ctrl+C operation.
Group marker selects the contract; it is not authentication. Metadata snapshots are not atomic or an ABA guarantee.
Child retains parent session and controlling terminal; only child PGID changes. Host signal handling and full run-linux remain unimplemented.
Legacy spawn APIs retain caller process-group setting and remove marker; console requires explicit isolated mode.
Creator thread must remain alive until child exits; trusted pre_exec hooks must not rebind group/session or selected FDs.
Direct PID/group signals, external group mutations and foreground signal delivery are not proven safe by these tests.
Complete cross-platform goal, advanced engine, desktop providers, packaging and driver work remain unfinished.
